plugin-data.name: jereme-dev-pro Companion
plugin-data.description: Companion plugin for the jereme-dev-pro theme.

jdpc-section-sidebar-subtitle: Three widgets that render in your sidebar, in this order: Categories → Latest Posts → About.
jdpc-section-external-subtitle: Behavior for anchors that point outside your own domain.
jdpc-section-stats-subtitle: Inject an analytics or web-stats snippet at body end on every page.
jdpc-section-version-subtitle: The version chip in the admin sidebar that polls version.bludit.com for newer releases.
jdpc-section-howitworks: How this plays with the theme
jdpc-enable-external-target-blank: Open external links in a new tab
jdpc-enable-version-check: Show the version chip in the admin sidebar
jdpc-dev-port-tip: If the request comes in on this port, the web stats snippet below is NOT emitted. Use this if you run a local copy of this admin (a dev mirror, a staging instance, or anything else that isn't production) on a specific port — without it, your own development traffic would show up in the production analytics and skew the numbers. Leave blank to always emit.
jdpc-stats-code-tip: Pasted verbatim into the body end on every page. Used for Statcounter / Plausible / similar.
jdpc-howitworks-external: A static page whose Description field is set to external will render with target="_blank" rel="noopener" in the About widget AND in the theme's footer aside.
jdpc-howitworks-404: A static page whose Description field is set to 404 is hidden from the About widget AND from the theme's footer aside. The page is still served at its URL — it just stops appearing in navigation. Set the Description to 404 on the page (usually a Static page) you want to serve as your site's not-found page.
jdpc-howitworks-archived: The Categories widget always sorts a category literally named Archived to the bottom of the list, regardless of alphabetical order.
jdpc-howitworks-targetblank: The 'open external links in new tab' setting injects a small script at body-end that walks every <a> on the rendered page and, for hosts that do not match the current one, sets target="_blank" and ensures rel includes noopener noreferrer (to prevent reverse-tabnabbing). Theme-rendered external anchors already include rel="noopener" inline; this script handles links inside post content.
